{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"FAQPage","mainEntity":[{"@type":"Question","name":"How do I get a quote for shipping my vehicle?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"You can either use our instant car shipping quote calculator above to get a free online quote or call us at (888) 422-7584 to receive a quote from a car transport pricing specialist."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"How much does it cost to ship a car?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"When determining your shipping rate, there are a few things we consider to provide you with an accurate price quote.
